content.short: BrownFi is a capital-efficient AMM deployed across several EVM chains including HyperEVM and Monad.
content.description: BrownFi runs a capital-efficient AMM design across a set of EVM networks, with HyperEVM and Monad among them alongside Berachain, Linea and Base. Deploying the same curve widely is how a small AMM team builds a track record without committing to a single ecosystem's fortunes.
content.meta: One capital-efficient AMM curve deployed across HyperEVM, Monad, Berachain, Linea and Base.
